item.description:
### Fixed - **Codex costs use current prices.** Perch's Codex price list was out of date, and a model it didn't know borrowed the price of an older one with a similar name. GPT-5.6 Sol, for example, was shown at about a third of its real cost, and GPT-6 Astra showed no cost at all. The list now matches OpenAI's published prices, including the GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 families.
### Changed - **A Codex cost that is incomplete says so.** When some of a session's work was on a model with no published price, the figure now ends in "+" (at least this much), or shows "~$?" when none of it could be priced, instead of looking exact or free. GPT-5.3 Codex Spark and Codex's automatic review model have no published price, so sessions using them now show this.
